correctness.rationale: For all n>=2 the irredundant tree order-polytope facets are exactly root nonnegativity, leaf upper bounds, and n-1 cover constraints. Every pair except upper-leaf/incident-cover with branching parent has a strict relative-interior witness via contracting selected edges or fixing 0/1 at endpoints. The exceptional pair forces an additional sibling upper equality. These yield K_(n+L) minus a matching of L-U. The complete normalized outward-normal Gram pattern has -1/sqrt2, -1/2, 0, +1/2 exactly with proven multiplicities; sums match R. The inequality W<=Δ(n-1)/2 and W>=choose(Δ,2) proves the iff right-angle criterion. Exhaustive independent vertex affine-rank and cosine checker for all free trees and all roots n=2..9 (748 cases) passes; enumeration is supporting, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an all-parameter, natural Euclidean codimension-two metric classification across rooted-tree order polytopes, with a sharp necessary-and-sufficient angular concentration theorem in terms of the maximum offspring ratio. It detects tree branch geometry invisible to mere face counts and sharply separates bounded-degree trees from giant-hub trees. It is not a repackaged volume, face-number, or arbitrary finite numerical calculation; the adjacency proof is an enabling lemma, not a free-standing novelty claim.
